compatibility.evidence: Current checked-in taxonomy with addedRuleIds removed reproduces the model source fingerprint exactly; added rules are outside the trained visual label index and remain deterministic-only.

dataset.splitPolicy: deterministic product-group split; no product or image crosses splits; staged in sequential 25 GB shards

training.resourcePolicy: two sequential <=25 GB raw shards; raw shard purged after each verified pass; OS-managed swap only

retention.rawDataPolicy: each marked shard is deleted immediately after adapter or final-encoder verification
